content.rendered:
?

1 Samuel 9:22 NLT
Then Samuel brought Saul and his servant into the hall and placed them at the head of the table, honoring them above the thirty special guests.
?
Saul was not on the guest list.
?Neither would he have been considered to be part of the meeting of noble men in the land.
?Saul rode on the shoulders of Samuel to get to the place of honour
?Saul came in last, yet, he was placed above those there before him.
?
✔God will send to you men/women upon whose shoulders (experiences, knowledge, connection) you will ride on into the place of honour.
?They may not look like those who could pull any “string” but, they will come & you will not miss them in Jesus name????
